angularDiameterSource: Stellar radius 0.939 ± 0.019 ± 0.011 solar radii from Mancini et al. 2018, A&A 613, A41 (2018). It is a radius from stellar characterisation, not an interferometric diameter; the angular diameter in the record is that radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia EDR3 parallax 4.6435 +/- 0.0144 mas via SIMBAD (2020yCat.1350....0G): 215.35 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius: 0.939 ± 0.019 ± 0.011 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius, from Mancini et al. 2018 (A&A 613, A41 (2018); arXiv:1802.03859). GM from their stellar mass 0.913 solar masses times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: no spin axis is measured, so the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 5485 ± 50 K from Mancini et al. 2018 (A&A 613, A41; https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.03859), Table 2, the radius source: iron-line equivalent widths in co-added HARPS-N spectra.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
